Nora (People Ops): Quick ask: building a tiny, pasteable 'micro-goal' template for self-reviews + manager notes. Must be scannable in 30s. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Rajat (Eng Manager): My go-to, 2-line + 3 bullets. Super copy/paste-able. Example below.
```
One-line: <Objective> | <Customer impact 6-10 words> | <Metric baseline->target>
3 bullets:
- Outcome: 1-2 sentences + PR/issue link
- Metric: baseline -> result (link to dashboard)
- Tradeoffs & risks: 1 line
Manager ask: explicit blocking asks (infra, design review, quota)
```
Lina (ML Eng): Add 'data source' for metrics (which dashboard/table). And a short 'regression blameless note' example: 
`Regressions: small accuracy dip in A/B test, root cause noisy eval set, mitigation - revert feature toggle`
Diego (Staff PM): For PMs reading calibration, include a single word expected result tag like met/partial/missed in the Manager recap. Helps sorting at a glance.
Nora (People Ops): Nice. Also want a 3-question manager prompt to paste into 1:1s: 
- What can I unblock this quarter?
- Which resource would make the biggest difference?
- Any calibration/context you want me to record?
perf-bot: Reminder: Performance window opens in 3 days. Timeline & FAQ: https://intra.redwood.ai/hr/perf :bell:
Nora (People Ops): Draft pack I'm about to publish: 1) Micro-goal template (one-line + bullets) 2) Manager 3Q prompt 3) Tone & evidence checklist 4) Example self-review snippet. Will pin in #people-ops. Quick pasteable example for the form: 
```
One-line: Reduce embeddings cost 15% | Improves freemium unit economics | cost/1k embeddings $0.78->$0.66
- Outcome: Implemented quantized encoder, PR: https://git.redwood.ai/PR/4231
- Metric: cost/1k embeddings $0.78 -> $0.64 (dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/embeddings)
- Tradeoffs & risks: slight cosine variance ~0.4%, monitor recall on high-precision queries
Manager ask: approve quota bump + sign-off on rollout plan
Manager recap tags: met
```
Nora (People Ops): If no objections I'll post this as the 'micro-goal' template in the performance templates page and link to examples. Please react with :thumbsup: if good or suggest changes.
